production.execution: CPU background CLI; no GPU renders or baked images
production.sourceOfCounts: CPU geometry inspection, including retained source geometry; not renderer measurements

authorship: Original programmatic hard-surface and plasma meshes modeled from the retained scene reference. No third-party geometry or textures. Project-authored original material shaders.
approximations: Prominences use bounded ray-integrated density fields derived from retained Blender plume pockets, with sparse modeled cores, simulation-time flow and layered radiance; no plasma fluid simulation.
Photosphere uses procedural cellular radiance, sunspot basins and filaments on an actual sphere; no stellar scientific simulation.
Static architecture retains CPU vertex contact shade and is merged by material and broad district to bound draw calls.
Two distant prominence lights and two local spill lights are unshadowed; three pooled point lights illuminate physical thermal fixtures. Exposure/shade modulates the level sun smoothly.
Emitted volume radiance is integrated before tone mapping and added once in both direct and HDR rendering; low reduces depth samples while retaining event geometry, timing and illumination.
